socfpga_mmu.h

MMU hardware abstraction driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

socfpga_mmu_make_block_descriptor
uint64_t socfpga_mmu_make_block_descriptor(
uint64_t 
physical_address,
uint32_t 
attr_index,
uint32_t 
shareability,
uint32_t 
access_permission,
bool 
execute_never
)

Constructs a 64-bit ARMv8 Translation Table Block Descriptor.

This function packs the physical base address and various VMSA memory attributes (cacheability, shareability, access permissions) into a single 64-bit entry suitable for insertion into an L1 or L2 translation table. This maps a large, contiguous block of memory (e.g., 2MB or 1GB) directly to a physical address space.

Parameters
physical_address
uint64_t

The 64-bit aligned physical base address for the memory block.

attr_index
uint32_t

The index (0-7) into the Memory Attribute Indirection Register (MAIR_ELx) defining the caching policies (e.g., Device-nGnRE, Normal Write-Back).

shareability
uint32_t

The shareability domain (0 = Non-shareable, 2 = Outer Shareable, 3 = Inner Shareable).

access_permission
uint32_t

The AP[2:1] bits determining read/write access and privilege level requirements.

execute_never
bool

Set to true to assert the XN/PXN (Execute Never) bit, preventing instruction fetches from this memory region (crucial for device IO).

Returns

The fully formatted 64-bit block descriptor ready to be written to page table memory.

socfpga_mmu_enable
int32_t socfpga_mmu_enable(
uint32_t 
exception_level,
uint64_t 
ttbr0,
uint64_t 
tcr,
uint64_t 
mair
)

Configures and activates the Memory Management Unit for the specified ARMv8 Exception Level.

This routine writes the caller-supplied translation table boundaries and caching definitions into the TCR_ELx and MAIR_ELx system registers. It then sets the TTBR0_ELx register to point to the base of the page tables in memory, issues the necessary TLB invalidations and barrier instructions (DSB, ISB), and finally sets the 'M' bit in the SCTLR_ELx register to enable address translation.

Parameters
exception_level
uint32_t

The target processor privilege level (1 for EL1, 2 for EL2, 3 for EL3).

ttbr0
uint64_t

The 64-bit physical address pointing to the base of the L0/L1 translation tables.

tcr
uint64_t

The pre-formatted 64-bit value for the Translation Control Register (TCR_ELx), defining granule size, physical address size, and region bounds.

mair
uint64_t

The pre-formatted 64-bit value for the Memory Attribute Indirection Register (MAIR_ELx), establishing the 8 available caching/memory types.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if an unsupported exception level is requested.

socfpga_mmu_disable
int32_t socfpga_mmu_disable(
uint32_t 
exception_level
)

Safely deactivates address translation for the specified Exception Level.

This function clears the 'M' (MMU Enable) and 'C' (Cache Enable) bits in the System Control Register (SCTLR_ELx). It performs necessary data synchronization barriers to ensure outstanding memory transactions complete, then invalidates the Translation Lookaside Buffers (TLBs) to guarantee no stale mappings remain cached by the processor.

Parameters
exception_level
uint32_t

The target processor privilege level (1 for EL1, 2 for EL2, 3 for EL3).

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if an unsupported exception level is requested.

socfpga_mmu_is_enabled
int32_t socfpga_mmu_is_enabled(
uint32_t 
exception_level,
bool 
*
enabled
)

Queries the hardware System Control Register (SCTLR_ELx) to determine if Stage 1 memory address translation is currently active for the specified Execution Level.

Parameters
exception_level
uint32_t

The target processor privilege level to query (1, 2, or 3).

enabled
bool*

Pointer to a boolean that will be set to true if the SCTLR_ELx.M bit is asserted, or false otherwise.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the pointer is NULL or the exception level is out of bounds.
